the heterosis for dry matter production in sorghum is due to heterosis in leaf area and that heterosis in photosynthesis and enzyme activity does not play a role in dry matter heterosis in sorghum.

heterosis for leaf area and photosynthetic rate is a key factor for dry matter production in Sorghum hybrids.
